description: 경찰청 대전광역시경찰청_8톤이상 화물자차량 교량복개도로구간 통행금지 현황 [roads, bridges and tunnels and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 경찰청 대전광역시경찰청. ​대전광역시에서는 교량 및 복개도로의 구조적 안전성과 도로 폭 협소 등의 이유로 8톤 이상 대형 화물차량의 통행을 제한하는 구간을 지정하여 운영하고 있음. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 경찰청 대전광역시경찰청. Its tags are 통행제한구간, 통행금지도로, 화물차량, 교통안전정보, 통과하중. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
